title: ImaginaryPink PVP
description: ImaginaryPink 16x Purple pvp resource pack on 1.8+
body:
# ImaginaryPink 16x 🪅

Imaginary is a vibrant PvP texture pack by Yuruze that completely overhauls Minecraft's monotonous colors. It is the perfect aesthetic alternative to standard competitive resource packs, built specifically for SkyWars and Bedwars players.
✨ Features

    Custom Color Themes: The standard version features a unique pink palette. Other color variants like Green, Red, Purple, and Baby Blue are also available.

    Shader-Like Sky: Includes beautiful, realistic clouds built straight into the pack without the performance drop of actual shaders.

    Redesigned PvP Gear: Weapons, armor, and essential combat items look much cleaner and sleeker than the default textures.
